t: A 4 inch touchscreen desk panel for smart home dashboards and LoRa mesh messages.
steps: Buy the model you need from Seeed Studio. Pick the D1L or D1Pro for Meshtastic.
Attach a LoRa antenna to the LoRa models before you power on.
Plug it into a 5 volt USB-C adapter and explore the screen.
Open the Meshtastic web flasher in a browser and flash the SenseCAP Indicator build.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone and pair it over Bluetooth.
Set your region and avoid the Repeater role, which causes reboot loops.
Try the ESPHome tutorial on the Seeed wiki for a Home Assistant dashboard.
meta: Open Board. From $44. A few stores.
